overview:
A trek in the Kinnaur district followed by a night in Kalpa: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** Yulla Kanda and Kalpa Trek leaves Delhi at night for an overnight journey to Tapri/Yulla. The trek is 24 km round trip, reaches a height of 13,500 ft and is graded easy to moderate.

Day 1 arrives in Tapri by late morning and is kept light for acclimatisation, with a trek briefing and dinner in the evening. Day 2 drives to Yulla Village and treks to Yulla Kanda, where a Krishna Temple stands beside a high-altitude lake, before descending to Yulla Base Camp for the night. Day 3 descends to Yulla Village and drives to Kalpa for an evening around Roghi Village, Suicide Point and Kinnaur Kailash View Point. Day 4 is the return journey to Delhi. Transport, two hotel nights, one night of camping, 3 breakfasts, 2 lunches, 3 dinners and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹10,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
Depart from Delhi at night.
Overnight journey to Tapri/Yulla in the Kinnaur district.

itinerary.title: Arrival and stay in Tapri/Yulla
itinerary.content:
Arrive in Tapri by late morning and check in to your hotel.
Take the day at a relaxed pace to acclimatise to the altitude. The day is kept light so you are ready for the trek.
The Sutlej River flows nearby.
In the evening, gather for a detailed trek briefing by your trip captain.
Dinner at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek from Yulla Village to Yulla Kanda | Base camp
itinerary.content:
After an early breakfast, drive to Yulla Village, the starting point of the trek.
The trail ascends gradually through alpine landscapes and open meadows.
The trek covers approximately 10 km and takes 4 to 6 hours, depending on pace.
A packed lunch is provided during the trek.
Reach Yulla Kanda, where a Krishna Temple, known as the world's highest, stands beside a high-altitude lake with views of the surrounding Himalayan ranges.
Descend to Yulla Base Camp by evening.
Dinner and overnight stay in camps.

itinerary.title: Descent and transfer to Kalpa
itinerary.content:
Breakfast at the campsite.
Descend from the base camp to Yulla Village and proceed by road to Kalpa, a village in Kinnaur.
Check in to your hotel and unwind.
In the evening, explore Roghi Village and Suicide Point.
Visit Kinnaur Kailash View Point.
See the traditional wooden architecture and the local monastery.
Walk through the apple orchards (seasonal).
Watch the sunset over the Kinnaur Kailash range.

itinerary.title: Return journey
itinerary.content:
Breakfast with a view of the Himalayan peaks.
Check out and begin the return journey to Delhi.
Overnight travel back to Delhi.
